name: Neon Coast
description: Midnight on a neon street. Your crew holds a corner of the district while the heat rises: one star is a few street punks, five stars is the whole neighbourhood coming for you. Grab a gun from the stash, seal the side streets before the gangs tear the shutters down, shoot the fuel barrels when they bunch up, and when the power dies and the signs go dark the real fight starts. Cash piles up with every one you drop. At the end the district boss rolls in.

modes.name: Standard
modes.description: Thirty seconds to arm up, then five stars of heat and the boss. Five waves in 10 minutes, six in 15.

modes.name: Short
modes.description: One wave fewer and shorter waves, for a quick round.
